mission_08: PCA can be used for noise reduction by projecting data onto the top principal components and then reconstructing it. The idea is that noise tends to be captured in the low-variance components, so by discarding these components and inverse-transforming, you effectively filter out noise. In this mission, you will create a noisy dataset, apply PCA to find the optimal number of components that capture 95% of variance, reconstruct the denoised data, and measure the reconstruction quality using mean squared error. This demonstrates PCA's dual role in both dimensionality reduction and denoising.
